headline: Recommended approval of Teamsters Local 251 contract, with a $252,047 total cost increase, and a related pay rate ordinance.
summary: The committee reviewed a three-year contract covering eleven union members. Salaries rise 3.25%, 3.25%, and 3.50%, and life insurance increases to $75,000. The committee recommended approval of the contract and of an ordinance setting the pay rates.
decisions: Placed the Personnel Board recommendation on the Teamsters Local 251 contract and pay plan on file.
Recommended approval of the Teamsters Local 251 collective bargaining agreement for July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029, 3-0.
Recommended approval of the ordinance repealing and replacing the Local 251 pay rate schedule in Section §88-12, 3-0.

plain_text:
PAWTUCKET CITY COUNCIL 
FINANCE COMMITTEE  
SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 
 
A meeting of the City Council Finance Committee was held on Thursday, September 10, 2026, 
at 5:56 p.m., in the Temporary City Council Office, Room 204, 2nd Floor, 100 Freight Street, 
Pawtucket, RI. 
 
Present - Councilor Wildenhain, Chair; Councilors Moran and Rubio. 
 
Absent – 0. 
 
Councilor Wildenhain presided. 
 
 
Also present were Gregg Anderson, Human Resources Coordinator; Jim DeCelles, Chief 
Engineer, PWSB; and Joseph A. Keough, Jr., Esq., Attorney for the PWSB. 
 
The Committee conducted a public input period, at which there were no speakers. 
 
 
The Committee took up the following: 
 
Communication from Gregg T. Anderson, Human Resources Coordinator, to the Personnel 
Board (Personnel Board Recommenda tion - Teamsters Local 251 New Contract and Pay Plan 
Effective July 1, 2026)  
 
This communication was READ AND ORDERED FILED. 
 
 
The Committee took up the following: 
 
Collective Bargaining Agreement by and Between Teamsters Local 251 and the Pawtucket 
Water Supply Board for the Period July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2029 
 
Mr. DeCelles stated that there are eleven teamsters in the union. 
 
He noted that this is a three -year contract, with salary increases of 3.25%, 3.25% and 3.50%.  
There is an increase in the phone stipend and an increase in life insurance to $75,000.  There is 
no increase in health insurance, which is already at 16% co -pay.  The total cost increase in the 
contract is $252,047.  They will do a rate filing to cover the cost of the agreement. 
 
Attorney Keough noted that the union tried to negotiate a decrease in the health insurance co -
pay. 
 
Mr. DeCelles stated that there are three positions upgraded in the contract.  Two of the 
positions deal with GIS and the third position deals with TOD.  They are tr ying to retain 
people.  It is hard to find people to work these jobs.  He noted that in today’s world GIS runs 
everything.
Finance Committee 
September 10, 2026 
Page 2 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Moran, seconded by Councilor Rubio, the Committee 
recommended APPROVAL of this agreement on a roll call vote, as follows: 
 
AYES – Councilor Wildenhain, Chair; Councilors Moran and Rubio 
 
NOES – 0. 
 
 
The Committee took up the following: 
 
AN ORDINANCE REPEALING AND REPLACING THE SCHEDULE OF PAY RATES 
FOR LOCAL 25 1 IN SECTION §88 -12 OF THE CODE OF ORDINANCES OF THE CITY 
OF PAWTUCKET, 1996 (Teamsters – 2026-2029) 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor  Rubio, seconded by Councilor  Moran, the Committee 
recommended APPROVAL of this ordinance on a roll call vote, as follows: 
 
AYES – Councilor Wildenhain, Chair; Councilors Moran and Rubio 
 
NOES – 0. 
 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 6:08 p.m. 
 
 
 
Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, City Clerk 
Pawtucket City Council
